name: Private application notes stay with their owner across independent browser sessions
description: Browser privacy companion to the mandatory native API ownership test 88b47334-232c-4665-a6a2-413b09c34eb5. Actual 404/403, foreign read exclusion and unchanged owner fields remain enforced by the separate required TestSprite API ownership check; browser visibility is not claimed as server enforcement.

planSteps.description: Sign in VAR_{other_email} with VAR_{password}; open the real Twente scholarship. Save if needed. Expand My application plan, set Private notes to [TEST ONLY] Owner-only application note, and Save my plan. Verify saved confirmation.
Sign out, then sign in VAR_{username} with VAR_{password}. Open the same Twente scholarship. Dismiss the unfinished-profile prompt if present.

Verify the owner-only note does not appear for this other account. If its own My application plan exists, expand it and verify Private notes is not [TEST ONLY] Owner-only application note. Verify there is no Operator navigation item.

Sign out and return as VAR_{other_email}. Open Twente, expand My application plan, and verify Private notes still equals [TEST ONLY] Owner-only application note. Required HTTP ownership enforcement is checked separately by the native API test, not inferred from hidden UI.
